title: Hearth Spirit
subtitle: You are the spirit of the hearth. Mark work, give orders, make demands.
intro: A small village keeps a temple to the spirit of the hearth: you. Mark squares for work with Mark (M), give standing orders and make demands with Orders, and spend your favour on golden rain and gifts of bread. The elder carries your word to the faithful.
orders: if more than two wolves come, wake bram

demands.text: Bring 2 bread to the temple as an offering.

onMet.narrate: The offering is made. The hearth burns brighter.

onMissed.narrate: No offering came. The hearth smoulders.

agents.personality: Ada, the village elder and keeper of the temple. You speak for the spirit of the hearth. You worry the young ones forget the old ways.
Wren, the baker. You bake before dawn and are proud of your loaves. You think Bram works too slowly.
Bram, a labourer. You carry, dig and build for anyone who asks. You want a house of your own one day.
Tilly, the farmer. You love your garden and talk to your plants. You think the elder fusses too much.
